snippet.title: Subnautica 2 | Dev Vlog - Welcome Aboard, Captains
snippet.description:
In our final Subnautica 2 Dev Vlog ahead of Early Access launch, Design Lead Anthony Gallegos walks you through some of the things you can expect when the game enters Early Access on May 14th.

From update types, to recommended specs, release time, and more, Anthony lays out the information you need to get ready for launch.

We’ll see you in the deep!
